sources.snippet: CENO-1B-base CENO-1B-base is the base pretraining checkpoint of the 1B CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs). It is part of the CENO DNA foundation model family. Model code, the VEP pipeline, and a generation demo live in the companion CENO code repository. This ...
